title: Light Ice Cream Bar, Vanilla, Chocolate Coated

content.title: About
content.content: A light ice cream bar with vanilla ice cream inside and a thin coating of milk chocolate. The product is designed for a quick snack, combining a gentle creamy vanilla flavor with a bittersweet chocolate note. The bar has lower calories compared to traditional ice cream sticks thanks to a lightened dairy base.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The bars are produced in small, portable portions ideal for on‑the‑go consumption.
Vanilla flavor is achieved with natural flavorings rather than synthetic additives.
The chocolate coating contains minimal trans‑fats, meeting modern health standards.
Often included in children’s menus because it melts easily and requires no extra cooling.
Light ice cream bars can fit into diet plans as they typically contain less than 150 kcal per 100 g.

items.title: Low calorie content
items.content: The light dairy formulation provides fewer calories than regular ice cream sticks, helping to maintain energy balance.

items.title: Source of calcium
items.content: The dairy component supplies calcium essential for bone and teeth health.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Vanilla flavoring and dairy base contain modest amounts of B2 and B12 vitamins, supporting metabolic processes.

items.title: Antioxidants from chocolate
items.content: The chocolate coating provides flavonoids that may help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Convenient protein source
items.content: Dairy protein contributes a small amount of protein, useful especially for growing children.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Contains milk, so it may trigger allergic reactions in individuals with lactose intolerance or casein allergy.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Despite the light formula, the bar still contains added sugar, which should be considered by people with diabetes or sugar restrictions.

items.title: Temperature sensitivity
items.content: When stored at high temperatures, the chocolate coating can melt and the ice cream may lose its texture.

items.title: Post‑opening storage
items.content: After opening, the product should be consumed within a few days to prevent microbial growth.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The bar is ready to eat straight from the package. For a firmer texture, you may briefly chill it in the freezer. Serve as a standalone dessert, add to fruit salads, or use as a sweet element in ice‑cream parfaits.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated and consume within 5‑7 days. For long‑term storage (over 3 months), keep in the freezer.
